cleaned_description: The checkout API is returning an HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on POST /orders when a promotional code is applied to an order. The issue appears to be caused by a null pointer exception within the DiscountService.calc method. The fault is consistently reproducible only on orders exceeding $200 in value. Temporary diagnostic logging has been added to assist with investigation.
short_summary: Checkout API returns HTTP 500 on POST /orders when a promo code is applied to orders over $200, likely due to a null pointer exception in DiscountService.calc.
customer_impact: Customers are unable to complete checkout when applying a promotional code to orders valued above $200, resulting in a failed order submission.
technical_details: Condition: Occurs only on orders exceeding $200
missing_information: Specific promo code(s) that trigger the issue, or whether it affects all promo codes
Full stack trace or error log output
Frequency and volume of affected orders
When the issue was first observed
Whether any recent deployments or code changes preceded the issue
suggested_next_step: Review the temporary logging output to obtain the full stack trace from DiscountService.calc. Identify the null reference — likely an unvalidated discount object or threshold condition — and apply a null check or guard clause. Confirm whether the $200 threshold is a hard boundary or approximate, and test with multiple promo codes across the boundary value.
tone_adjustment: The original note was technically concise and professionally neutral. No emotional or unprofessional language was present. Minor grammatical expansion was applied for clarity and formality.
